A restaurant manager records the total time $20$ customers waited before they were seated. The results are presented in the table below.

| Waiting time (minutes) | Frequency |
| --- | ---: |
| $0 \le x < 10$ | $4$ |
| $10 \le x < 15$ | $6$ |
| $15 \le x < 20$ | $7$ |
| $20 \le x < 30$ | $3$ |

Find an estimate of the mean waiting time $x^(―)$, rounded to **one decimal place**.

Rounded to one decimal place, $x^(―) \approx$
{{field-1}} minutes.

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
